note: Analyst reading of the news, written by the weekly agent from logged events. Not data. Replace every week.
headline: Shipping attacks rose: UKMTO reports a tanker hit leaving Hormuz on Nov 20 and two more on Nov 21, with no casualties reported (#191, #193); Iran claims more ships hit its mines (#190, not confirmed).

On Nov 21 an Iranian attack set fire to an industrial site in Sitra, Bahrain; reports differ on injuries and a US official says US forces were not affected (#194). Iran claims two more US drones shot down; CENTCOM has not commented (#195).
No new US strike confirmed: CENTCOM denied an Iranian report of a missile hit on Qeshm on Nov 20 (#192); the last confirmed US strike is Nov 17 (#179).

No deal and no direct talks: Trump says Iran fired more drones and missiles last week than at any time in over a year (#196); Iran says Hormuz can be safe quickly if the US lifts the blockade and sanctions (#197); Qatar's mediators were in Tehran on Nov 21 (not confirmed as US-Iran talks).
